3Echo Point

The shortest trail in the park, and the one almost everybody does. It climbs 790 feet through the trees from the lodge to a bluff at 4,330 feet with a rail along the edge. It's steep, but you're back in about an hour.

Status
Open
Distance
1.1 mi
Climb
790 ft
Time
1 hr
Start
Basin Lodge trailhead
Terrain
Short and steep, through the trees to a rail at the top.

How the echo works

Shout from the rail at Echo Point and you'll hear it four more times. Four cliffs on the slope below Halloran Meadows face the point, the nearest about 600 feet off and the farthest more than half a mile, and sound only travels about 1,100 feet a second. The last echo takes five and a half seconds to get back. June does a short echo talk up there at 10 and 2, and she brings a stopwatch.
